name: io.github.chrischall/onehome-mcp
description: OneHome (CoreLogic) real-estate access for Claude — search, property details, photos, saved homes

environmentVariables.name: ONEHOME_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for services.onehome.com. Paste the raw JWT (Authorization header value, minus the 'Bearer ' prefix) from your signed-in portal.onehome.com session.

environmentVariables.name: ONEHOME_MAGIC_LINK
environmentVariables.description: Magic-link URL with ?token=... from your real-estate agent. The MCP extracts the token query param and uses it directly as the bearer.

environmentVariables.name: ONEHOME_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Override the fetchproxy WebSocket port (default 37149). Only used when ONEHOME_TOKEN / ONEHOME_MAGIC_LINK are unset and the MCP boots in capture-from-tab mode.

environmentVariables.name: ONEHOME_COMMUNITIES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON array of community names used for feature extraction; overrides the built-in Lake Lure / mountain-NC default vocabulary.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
